Package Name: Dell Compellent Integration Tools for VMware (CITV)
Method of Attack: Use of a hardcoded static AES encryption key shared across all installs to encrypt vCenter admin credentials, allowing attackers to decrypt stored credentials and retrieve cleartext passwords.
Impacted Systems: Dell Compellent Integration Tools for VMware (CITV)
Attack Vector: Extraction of hardcoded AES key from a decompiled JAR file in the Dell Compellent software directory
Access to the server with weak credentials (admin/admin)
Local user or low-privileged external attacker with access to Dell CITV
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of a JAR file containing the hardcoded AES key in the Dell Compellent software directory
Decrypted configuration files revealing vCenter admin credentials
